tools.name: search_certifications
tools.description: Which certification is this prose name? Start here for any plain question — a trade, field, job, skill, or company in everyday words. Returns candidates with ids, issuers, and source basis — candidates rather than a single guess when the name is ambiguous; the ids feed the other certification tools.

tools.name: get_certification
tools.description: Everything held about one certification: issuer and issuer domain, occupations served, exam and renewal requirements, education-or-experience routes, Credential Engine registry identity where held, and the basis and source URL for the claim.

tools.name: certifications_for_occupation
tools.description: What certifications serve this occupation? SOC-keyed lookup (dashed SOC accepted with or without the O*NET .00 suffix).

tools.name: occupations_for_certification
tools.description: What occupations does this certification serve?

tools.name: related_certifications
tools.description: What else serves the same occupation? Traverses on SOC only — a certification sharing solely an instructional program (CIP) is not related (contract § 4).

tools.name: certifications_for_program
tools.description: Broad academic cross-reference by instructional program (CIP). A deliberately broader, lower-precision question than an occupation lookup — never its peer (contract § 4).

tools.name: list_issuers
tools.description: The issuing organizations, optionally filtered by a name query.

tools.name: resolve_term

tools.name: expand_term
tools.description: What is this word, upward? Walks the WordNet is-a (hypernym) chain meaning to parent meaning, from the word's KSA-mapped sense toward its broader categories, so every step stays in the sense it started in. Each step carries its definition (gloss) and synonyms.

tools.name: get_dictionary_summary
tools.description: What does the KSA Dictionary hold? tools.name: crosswalk_code
tools.description: What does this code cross to? Auto-detects the family — dotted CIP (52.0201) or dashed SOC (11-1021, O*NET .00 suffix accepted) — and answers the other family's codes and titles from the federal CIP-SOC crosswalk.

tools.name: get_checklist

tools.name: get_institution

tools.name: find_catalogs
tools.description: Which published catalog editions are held for this institution? Each catalog's edition year, format and source. Answers none held when the build holds none.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: One catalog edition: its row, the institutions that use it (and whom it is shared from), and how many programs it holds.

tools.name: find_programs
tools.description: Which programs match these words, across institutions? Program or award words (optionally one institution's UNITID) answer with each program's award, CIP, published credit figure verbatim, edition, source page and institution.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: One program whole: its row, identifiers, offerings (campus resolved), its institution, and the checklists that lead to its award — pass one to get_checklist.

tools.name: get_learning_unit
tools.description: One course whole: its row, prerequisites and corequisites, aliases, terms offered, articulation statements and comparable members — each linked course resolved or stated unresolved, never guessed — plus the transfer frameworks it maps to.

tools.name: find_policies
tools.description: Which academic policies does this institution publish (transfer credit, prior learning, tuition and fees …)? Optional words narrow them. Answers none held when the build holds none.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: One published academic policy: its section, verbatim text, page, edition and source.

tools.name: find_checklists
tools.description: Which checklists — the generic itinerary of requirements for an award — does this institution publish? Optional award words or a program id narrow them; pass one to get_checklist.

tools.name: find_agreements
tools.description: Which articulation or transfer agreements are held? Optional title words, or an institution's UNITID as a party. Answers none held when the build holds none.

tools.name: get_agreement
tools.description: One agreement: its row, its parties (organizations resolved), and the pathways, comparability bundles and checklists that cite it. Signatories name people and are not served.

tools.name: find_pathways
tools.description: Which pathways are held? Optional title words, an agreement id, or a checklist id. Answers none held when the build holds none.

tools.name: get_pathway
tools.description: One pathway: its row and the checklist and agreement it links. Contacts name people and are not served.

tools.name: find_comparability
tools.description: Which comparability bundles (published transfer rules) are held? Optional receiving institution UNITID, agreement id, or a learning unit that appears as a source or substitute. Answers none held when the build holds none.

tools.name: get_comparability
tools.description: One comparability bundle: its row (credits awarded published beside any parse), the receiving institution, and its source and substitute courses, each resolved or stated unresolved.

tools.name: find_transfer_frameworks
tools.description: Which statewide or compact transfer frameworks are held? Optional name or jurisdiction words. Answers none held when the build holds none.

tools.name: get_transfer_framework
tools.description: One transfer framework: its row, authority, codes with their meanings, and the courses mapped to it (resolved).

tools.name: checklists_requiring_learning_unit
tools.description: Which checklists require this course? Each requirement item that resolved to it, with its checklist id, award and group heading. Items that did not resolve to a course are never guessed into this list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_certifications, get_certification, assemble_my_formal_education · Private data: get_certification, programs_for_institution, get_institution, get_pathway, search_programs_and_learning_units, get_courseshelf_summary, find_transitions, compare_destinations, assemble_my_formal_education, assemble_my_work_and_credentials, assert_my_life_experiences, my_selfie_ksa_view, draft_my_claims · Public sink: programs_for_institution, learning_units, find_policies, find_checklists · Destructive: find_catalogs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_certifications, get_certification, assemble_my_formal_education · Private data: get_certification, programs_for_institution, get_institution, get_pathway, search_programs_and_learning_units, get_courseshelf_summary, find_transitions, compare_destinations, assemble_my_formal_education, assemble_my_work_and_credentials, assert_my_life_experiences, my_selfie_ksa_view, draft_my_claims · Public sink: programs_for_institution, learning_units, find_policies, find_checklists · Destructive: find_catalogs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
